packageRules.description: Keep Astro and @astrojs/* majors in one PR
Keep the ESLint + typescript-eslint family's majors in one PR
One weekly PR for every non-major devDependency update, auto-merged after CI passes
One weekly PR for every non-major runtime dependency update. These build dist/, so they wait for review
One PR for every GitHub Actions update, majors included. deploy.yml only runs on push to main, so no PR run exercises these and they always wait for review
Never auto-merge majors — they carry real risk and want human review

Leave the pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides alone. Each is a hand-set CVE floor aimed at a vulnerable range, and raising one drags every consumer of that range along with it: #82 and #83 moved fast-uri and nanoid consumers across majors that way

Hold typescript majors. typescript-eslint throws at module load on an unsupported TS major, so `pnpm lint` fails before `pnpm check` is even reached — see typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint#10940, which targets TS >=7.1. @astrojs/check also still caps its typescript peer at ^6, so both want to move before this is worth reopening.
Pin visual/perf-load-bearing libs to exact versions so a silent minor can't change behavior unannounced
